title: Calling the First Disciples and Healings

questions.question: While the crowd was pressing in on Jesus to hear the word of God by the lake of Gennesaret, whose boat did He get into to teach them from the water?
options: Simon's boat
James's boat
John's boat
A Pharisee's boat
questions.explanation: Luke 5:3 (ESV): "Getting into one of the boats, which was Simon's, he asked him to put out a little from the land. And he sat down and taught the people from the boat."

questions.question: When He had finished speaking, what did Jesus tell Simon to do?
options: "Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch."
"Take me across to the other side."
"Gather your friends, for a storm is coming."
"Leave your boat and follow me immediately."
questions.correctAnswer: "Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch."
questions.explanation: Luke 5:4 (ESV): "And when he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, 'Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.'"

questions.question: How did Simon respond to Jesus' command to let down the nets?
options: "Master, we toiled all night and took nothing! But at your word I will let down the nets."
"Lord, it is not the right time of day to fish."
"We have already washed the nets, return tomorrow."
"I am too tired from the night, I will do it later."
questions.correctAnswer: "Master, we toiled all night and took nothing! But at your word I will let down the nets."
questions.explanation: Luke 5:5 (ESV): "And Simon answered, 'Master, we toiled all night and took nothing! But at your word I will let down the nets.'"

questions.question: What happened when they let down the nets?
options: They enclosed a large number of fish, and their nets were breaking
They caught one massive fish that fed the multitude
The nets brought up nothing, but the fish jumped into the boat
They caught ancient treasures from the bottom of the sea
questions.correctAnswer: They enclosed a large number of fish, and their nets were breaking
questions.explanation: Luke 5:6 (ESV): "And when they had done this, they enclosed a large number of fish, and their nets were breaking."

questions.question: When Simon Peter saw the miraculous catch, what did he do?
options: He fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord."
He rejoiced and promised half the catch to the temple
He hugged Jesus and thanked Him for the wealth
He asked Jesus to be a partner in their fishing guild
questions.correctAnswer: He fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord."
questions.explanation: Luke 5:8 (ESV): "But when Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, 'Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord.'"

questions.question: Who were partners with Simon that were also astonished at the catch?
options: James and John, sons of Zebedee
Philip and Bartholomew
Thomas and Matthew
Judas and Thaddaeus
questions.correctAnswer: James and John, sons of Zebedee
questions.explanation: Luke 5:10 (ESV): "and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon..."

questions.question: What did the men do when they brought their boats to land?
options: They left everything and followed him
They sold the fish and gave the money to Jesus
They invited him to a great feast
They repaired their torn nets before following him
questions.correctAnswer: They left everything and followed him
questions.explanation: Luke 5:11 (ESV): "And when they had brought their boats to land, they left everything and followed him."

questions.question: A man full of leprosy came to Jesus, fell on his face, and begged Him, "Lord, if you will, you can make me clean." Jesus touched him and said what?
options: "I will; be clean."
"Your faith has healed you."
"Go in peace, your sins are forgiven."
"Wash in the pool of Siloam."
questions.explanation: Luke 5:13 (ESV): "And Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, 'I will; be clean.' And immediately the leprosy left him."

questions.question: Why did men have to bring a paralyzed man on a bed down through the tiles into the midst of the crowd before Jesus?
options: Because they could not find a way to bring him in because of the crowd
Because the religious leaders locked the door
Because it was a custom to heal from above
Because the man was too loud and offended the guards
questions.correctAnswer: Because they could not find a way to bring him in because of the crowd
questions.explanation: Luke 5:19 (ESV): "but finding no way to bring him in, because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and let him down with his bed through the tiles into the midst before Jesus."

questions.question: When Jesus saw their faith, what was the first thing He declared to the paralyzed man?
options: "Man, your sins are forgiven you."
"Rise and walk, your illness is gone."
"I see your suffering, and it is finished."
"You are blessed among men."
questions.explanation: Luke 5:20 (ESV): "And when he saw their faith, he said, 'Man, your sins are forgiven you.'"

questions.question: Who thought Jesus was blaspheming because only God can forgive sins?
options: The scribes and the Pharisees
The Romans and the Centurion
The crowd of onlookers
The disciples of John the Baptist
questions.explanation: Luke 5:21 (ESV): "And the scribes and the Pharisees began to question, saying, 'Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God alone?'"

questions.question: Jesus proved His authority to forgive sins on earth by telling the paralyzed man to do what?
options: "I say to you, rise, pick up your bed and go home."
"Jump up and praise God loudly."
"Walk to the temple and show the priest."
"Wash your hands and eat with me."
questions.correctAnswer: "I say to you, rise, pick up your bed and go home."
questions.explanation: Luke 5:24 (ESV): "...he said to the man who was paralyzed—'I say to you, rise, pick up your bed and go home.'"

questions.question: Whom did Jesus find sitting at the tax booth and say "Follow me"?
options: Levi
Zacchaeus
Bartimaeus
Cornelius
questions.explanation: Luke 5:27 (ESV): "After this he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi, sitting at the tax booth. And he said to him, 'Follow me.'"

questions.question: When the Pharisees grumbled that Jesus was eating and drinking with tax collectors and sinners at Levi's great feast, what did Jesus reply?
options: "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I have not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance."
"They provide the food, so I eat with them."
"In the end, all will be judged equally."
"My disciples are hungry, and so am I."
questions.correctAnswer: "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I have not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance."
questions.explanation: Luke 5:31-32 (ESV): "And Jesus answered them, 'Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I have not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance.'"

questions.question: When answering why His disciples do not fast like John's disciples, Jesus gives a parable about new wine. What happens if you put new wine into old wineskins?
options: The new wine will burst the skins and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed
The old skins will cure the new wine better
The new wine will turn bitter and undrinkable
The old skins will stretch but the taste will remain the same
questions.correctAnswer: The new wine will burst the skins and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed
questions.explanation: Luke 5:37 (ESV): "And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed."

key_verse_text: And Jesus answered them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I have not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance."
